notes: Vertical stainless-steel vapour-phase LN2 freezer, not a cryostat: no vacuum sample space, no windows, no sample wiring, no magnet. Scene = 1618 mm tall cylinder (inner vessel 1422 mm dia; outer shell slightly larger, unpublished) with 635 mm neck and hinged lid at the 985 mm liftover line, 54 large + 30 mini square racks (13 shelves) standing on a vapour platform above a 292 L LN2 pool; enclosed plumbing/electronics work surface with TEC 3000 or touch screen; two-tier folding step. Only moving things: hinged lid, manual turn tray, solenoid-controlled LN2 fill and lid-vented boil-off. Catalog document list points at the labrepco mirror of the same ML-000019 Rev 0 spec sheet; URLs here are the mvebio.com originals verified in research/v5/cache (0d5eb2789a332582, 13289499-R, CryoVerse manual). Rev 3 of ML-000019 (2025 catalog) revises 1879P neck to 627 mm and height to 1619 mm.
